game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening
game.blurb: Action-adventure remake of the 1993 Game Boy game, set on Koholint Island, from Grezzo, released 2019-09-20 on Nintendo Switch. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters follow the dungeon page names in StrategyWiki's walkthrough contents for the original game.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the right game: "The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening (2019)", id 292842, slug the-legend-of-zelda-links-awakening; the 1993 original is a separate entry (slug the-legend-of-zelda-links-awakening-dx). StrategyWiki has the remake under "The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening (Nintendo Switch)", a stub at completion stage 0 where only the Table of Contents is written (Gameplay, New features and Walkthrough are linked but missing). Its guide for the original, "The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening", is at completion stage 2 with 19 written subpages; its contents list 12 walkthrough chapter pages after the short Walkthrough intro, and only 6 are written (The Mysterious Forest, Tail Cave, Before Bottle Grotto, Bottle Grotto, Key Cavern, Color Dungeon), while Angler's Tunnel, Catfish's Maw, Face Shrine, Eagle's Tower, Turtle Rock and Wind Fish's Egg are missing. Because half the walkthrough is unwritten and it covers the original, not the remake, it was not used as a guide (swUsed not set, no sw-structure entry); only its page names set the dungeon order of the chapters, with no text copied. That order should be checked against the remake. Chamber Dungeon, Color Dungeon and Hero Mode come from page names linked from the remake's Fandom page. zelda.fandom.com answers the API under "The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening (Nintendo Switch)" with about 193 linked articles (the plain title is the 1993 game's page); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
